newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa wheat crop forecast revised down slightly.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa wheat crop forecast revised down slightly.

text.p: The National Crop Estimates Committee said on Friday it had reduced its estimate of South African wheat production in 1996/97 to 2.562 million tonnes from 2.571 million forecast a month ago.
The committee said the estimated area under wheat remained around 1.293 million hectares from the 1.36 million last season.
It said the 8,500 tonnes reduction in the crop was mainly due to serious damage caused by wind storms in the Northern Cape and dry conditions in certain parts of the Eastern Cape.
"In total, however, the estimate still indicates an excellent crop," the committee said in a statement.
The new crop will be harvested from this month. The bulk of the crop is produced in the Western Cape and Free State provinces.
